set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWY8W7DP7TBKH918WVRG20YW. Problem: StepReceipt is enough for execution tests but not for durable inspection. Define a pure receipt/provenance model with graph id, node descriptions, dependency ids, artifact kinds, statuses, messages, runner/interpreter metadata, and optional user metadata. Acceptance: no file IO or JSON dependency in shared core; receipts render to deterministic text or structured values; tests cover success, failure, skipped nodes, and Future runner metadata.
set.title: Pipeline: formalize pure receipts and provenance
